Date APRIL 29, 1938.
Subject Offer of a gratuity of $50.00 per day in order to induce
corrupt practices amongst the Foreign and Japanese members of the S.M.P. on
duty at the Garden Bridge.
Made by S.I. Furness. Forwarded by (Signature)

C.P.
I interviewed
Mr. Ferris
in my office
on April 29
and warned
him that
any further
efforts of
this nature
would lead
to serious
consequences
to himself.

DEPUTY COMM.
28 APR. 1938
(DIVISIONS)

D. C. (DIVISIONS).
A suggestion has been made to me that this information should be given to the Japanese Authorities, and any police warned to be on the look out for this man.
D.O."C". R. Coutts.
D.D.O."C".

Sir,
I respectfully wish to bring to your notice confidential-
ly the following:-
At 6.30 p.m. April 26, 1938, whilst on duty at the
Garden Bridge I was approached by a Mr. W. H. Ferris, British,
who intimated that he wished to have a confidential chat with me.
Mr. Ferris informed me that he would pay me a gratuity
of fifty dollars($50.00) per day if I would agree and arrange
with the Japanese members of the S.M.P. on duty at the Garden
Bridge for the free passage of his trucks over the Bridge with
cargoes removed from the Northern Areas of the Settlement
without the necessary permits from the Japanese Naval Authori-
ties.
I was given to understand that the $50.00 would be
for my own personal use should I agree to negotiate and that
I would not be required to share this sum with the Japanese
members of the S.M.P. whose demands would be given separate
consideration if they agreed to co-operate in carrying out the
scheme.
Mr. Ferris requested that I give the suggestion
consideration and let him have my decision the following morning
(April 27).
Mr. Ferris claims to be the Manager of a concern known
as the Commercial Service Representatives, Room 502/3, 169 Yuen
Ming Yuen Road.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently
(Signature) Furness
S.I.

档案号 F 2816/51
虹口巡捕房，
日期 1938年4月29日
主题：提议每日支付50.00美元酬金，以诱使在外白渡桥执勤的工部局警务处外籍及日籍警员进行腐败行为。
由特别调查员 Furness 提出。转呈人（签名）

警务处长
我于4月29日在我的办公室会见了 Ferris 先生，并警告他，任何此类进一步的行为将导致他自身面临严重后果。

副警务处长
1938年4月28日
（各部门）

分区副警务处长。
有人向我建议，应将此情报告知日本当局，并警告所有警员留意此人。
代理总巡官 "C"。R. Coutts。
副总巡官 "C"。

阁下，
谨此 confidentially 向阁下呈报如下事项：
1938年4月26日下午6时30分，当本人正在外白渡桥执勤时，一位英籍人士 W. H. Ferris 先生接近本人，表示希望与本人进行私下谈话。
Ferris 先生告知本人，如果本人同意并与在外白渡桥执勤的工部局警务处日籍警员安排，使其卡车在未取得日本海军当局必要许可证的情况下，自由通过大桥运送从租界北区运出的货物，他将每日支付本人五十美元（$50.00）的酬金。
本人获悉，如果本人同意进行交涉，这50.00美元供本人个人使用，本人无需与工部局警务处的日籍警员分享这笔款项；如果他们同意合作执行该计划，对他们的要求将另行考虑。
Ferris 先生请本人考虑该建议，并于次日早晨（4月27日）告知决定。
Ferris 先生声称是一家名为“商业服务代表处”（Commercial Service Representatives）的机构的经理，地址为圆明园路169号502/3室。

此致
敬礼
（签名）Furness
特别调查员

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............
S.1 Special Branch....XStation
REPORT
Date January 4, 19 37.

Subject "Commercial Service Representatives," private enquiry agents.

Made by D.P.S. Henchman Forwarded by (Sgd.) G.N. Moore D.S.I.

With reference to the attached letter-head I have to
state that the concern known as "Commercial Service Representa-
tives" is a branch of the firm of "Kentwells" Law Offices,
run by L.K. Kentwell (File I.O. 4101). This firm occupies the
greater part of the 3rd floor at No. 505 Honan Road, the branch
referred to above occupies one small room and is managed by W.H.
Ferris, a British Eurasian, who, until recently, was employed as
a representative by the Crown Life Insurance Company. Ferris
is believed to have misappropriated certain funds entrusted to
him on behalf of the insurance company and though he was not
prosecuted, it is alleged that it was on this account that he
was dismissed. Ferris, suffering from an internal complaint,
is at present a patient in the General Hospital; his address
is at 836 Avenue Joffre.

The staff of "Commercial Service Representatives" consists
of Ferris and of Ferris alone. This rather inadequate personnel
would seem to preclude the possibility of the firm being able
to carry out the various kinds of commercial service which they
list on their pretentious letter-head. Business is in fact
very small and there is no reason to suppose that apart from
L.K. Kentwell, the firm has other legal advisers.

Kentwell's staff consists of a Chinese lawyer, Tang Wei
Chung, and six or seven Chinese clerks.

(Sgd.) D. Henchman.
D. P. S.

D.C. (Special Branch).

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案号............
特别科....X巡捕房
报告
日期 1937年1月4日。

主题：“商业服务代表处”，私人调查机构。

由侦探警佐 Henchman 提出 转呈人（签名）G.N. Moore 高级侦探督察

关于附上的信头，本人须声明，名为“商业服务代表处”的机构是“Kentwells”律师事务所的一个分支，由 L.K. Kentwell 经营（档案 I.O. 4101）。该事务所占据河南路505号三楼的大部分区域，上述分支机构占用一个小房间，由 W.H. Ferris 管理，他是一名英籍欧亚混血儿，直到最近还受雇于皇冠人寿保险公司担任代表。据信 Ferris 挪用了代表保险公司托管的某些资金，虽然未被起诉，但据称他因此被解雇。Ferris 患有内脏疾病，目前是广慈医院（General Hospital）的病人；他的住址是霞飞路836号。

“商业服务代表处”的员工仅由 Ferris 一人组成。这种明显不足的人员配置似乎排除了该公司能够履行其在那份浮夸的信头上列出的各种商业服务的可能性。事实上，业务量非常小，没有理由推测除 L.K. Kentwell 外，该事务所还有其他法律顾问。

Kentwell 的员工包括一名中国律师唐伟忠（Tang Wei Chung，音译）和六七名中国职员。

（签名）D. Henchman。
侦探警佐。

特别科副警务处长。

The Shanghai Evening Post

65
No 8 D. 1422

* * *
Non-Registered Britons
Fined By Magistrate

In the British police court yes-
terday, Magistrate C. H. Haines
fined Mr. William Hooper Ferris
$20 for having failed to register
for four years from 1935 to 1938
inclusive. Also appearing before
Mr. Haines was William Alfrew
Morgan who was also fined $20
for having failed to register from
1934 to 1937 inclusive. Both were
given two months in which to pay
their fines. A warning was issued
to British subjects who are not
registered.

《上海晚邮报》

65
No 8 D. 1422

* * *
未注册英籍人士
被裁判官罚款

昨日在英国警察法庭，裁判官 C. H. Haines 对 William Hooper Ferris 先生处以20美元罚款，原因是他在1935年至1938年（含首尾两年）期间未能进行注册。同样出庭受审的还有 William Alfrew Morgan，他也因在1934年至1937年（含首尾两年）期间未能注册而被处以20美元罚款。两人均获两个月期限缴纳罚款。并向未注册的英籍臣民发出了警告。
